task: cross-country crop classification with selective risk-controlled early stopping

selective_risk_contract.risk_population: automatically labelled samples only; deferred samples receive no automatic crop label
selective_risk_contract.multiplicity: Bonferroni over the five fixed candidates and two bounds per candidate
selective_risk_contract.classwise_reporting: descriptive only; no class-conditional guarantee is claimed

separation_rules: The official Estonia validation split is exploratory only for this redesigned route.
The fresh target-risk-calibration split must not be used to fit either classifier.
The official Estonia test labels are used only once after policy freezing for final reporting.
Do not choose targets, candidate thresholds, or the split after reading fresh calibration outcomes.
